cand.title: Future Travel World Toronto 2027
cand.organizationName: Future Travel World / Viva Vita Expos

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two organizer-side contact candidates, not two verified Toronto housing buyers: Victor (surname unpublished), identified by Apex as Global Event Partnerships Director and elsewhere Business Director, is the strongest commercial routing contact; Gabriele Elisabeth Lange, rendered “LANGE GABRIELE ELISABETH” in the reported registry appointment, is a corporate-administrator escalation candidate only. Her Toronto operating responsibility and current procurement authority are not established. No named Toronto event/housing manager or room-contract signatory was found. Sources: https://apexmasterexpos.com/app/events/ ; https://sociosycargos.es/empresa/apex-business-group-worldwide-sl-1485124
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced activity dates: May 13–16, 2027, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. May 13 is the B2B Travel Market; May 14–16 public/trade programming. These are event dates, not article dates. The edition falls within the requested horizon. The page says tickets are not on general sale yet. Announced dates do not establish operational delivery or a venue contract. Source: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications and the published audience: qualify a limited organizer, speaker, exhibitor, hosted-buyer or VIP room block and small side meetings, not exclusive show housing or the full expo. A 15–109 peak-room discussion is a hotel sales targeting range only, NOT event demand. The 157-room property and approximately 240-theatre largest room cannot be assumed to accommodate an unknown-size four-day exhibition. City-hotel utility, rather than resort suitability, is the relevant thesis for this Toronto edition; resorts are an exhibitor category, not a requirement for the host venue. Harbourfront/MTCC convenience becomes commercially useful only once the site is confirmed. No catering or restaurant availability is assumed. Event audience source: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/
findings.venueCommitments: Exact Future Travel World venue: unknown; official wording is “Venue to be announced.” City: Toronto; region: Ontario; country: Canada. Toronto is the advertised destination, but Toronto-proper site boundaries and Harbourfront/downtown/MTCC/Exhibition Place proximity cannot be established without an address. A separate VIVAVITA Masterclasses listing for the same dates names Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel, 123 Queen St W, Toronto, Ontario: a potentially relevant competing-hotel signal, NOT proof that Future Travel World itself has contracted that venue or guestrooms. Sources: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/ ; https://alpha-academy.ticketbud.com/vivavita-masterclasses-in-toronto-leadership-ai-business-marketing
findings.historicalRotation: No verified past Toronto edition or Toronto venue-rotation timeline was located. The official travel-show calendar lists multiple city editions in 2026–2027; this establishes an advertised multicity circuit, not annual Toronto recurrence or completed historical events. A Hawaii ticket listing advertises November 12–15, 2026 at Sheraton Waikiki Beach Resort, but is listing evidence only, not proof the event occurred or that rooms were contracted. No next Toronto edition after 2027 was found officially announced. Sources: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/cities/ ; https://www.eventbrite.com/e/future-travel-worldtm-hawaii-international-travel-experience-show-tickets-1997964174630
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. The Toronto edition page says “Venue to be announced” and “Exhibiting, sponsorship or group tickets ... info@gotoapex.com”; it publishes no accommodation-sourcing quotation, housing bureau, host-hotel block, booking code, room allotment or open hotel RFP. No hotels are listed there as Toronto housing partners. Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel is named only on the separate same-date masterclass listing, without a lodging block. Do not equate group-ticket enquiries with group-room procurement. Sources: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/ ; https://alpha-academy.ticketbud.com/vivavita-masterclasses-in-toronto-leadership-ai-business-marketing
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial expo/ecosystem organizer, not established as an association meeting. Future Travel World is marketed on the VIVAVITA site; VIVAVITA identifies itself with the Apex ecosystem. Apex legal terms identify Apex Business Group Worldwide S.L., Spain, CIF B93697449, as main organizer for exhibitor services, and distinguish Apex-organized events from third-party listings. Confirm the edition-specific contracting entity. No separately appointed Toronto PCO, DMC or housing agency was identified. Sources: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/ ; https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/ ; https://www.abc-worldwide.com/apexlegahub/
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced sell-out, overflow, displaced-room demand or Toronto hotel allocation was located. The same-date Sheraton Centre masterclass listing warrants checking an incumbent relationship but proves neither travel-show venue exclusivity nor committed lodging. Attendance, peak rooms and room nights for Future Travel World Toronto are unpublished in the reviewed edition materials. Generic VIVAVITA calendar claims of 250–350 congress delegates and 1,500–3,000+ weekend visitors are broader-series marketing, not Toronto travel-show forecasts; the masterclass cap of 50 per session is also not travel-show attendance. Sources: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/ ; https://alpha-academy.ticketbud.com/vivavita-masterclasses-in-toronto-leadership-ai-business-marketing ; https://vivavitaexpos.com/calendar/
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send a short qualification enquiry to the Toronto-published info@gotoapex.com, addressed to Victor/the Toronto operations lead. Request the legal contracting entity, event venue and signed/held status, event-specific attendance and nonlocal share, arrival/departure pattern, peak rooms/room nights, all incumbent housing hotels and any bureau, and the named lodging decision-maker plus a second operations contact. Ask whether the Sheraton Centre masterclass listing belongs to this travel-show programme. Offer a site inspection and a modest lodging/side-meeting proposal only after these answers; verify catering internally first. No speculative inventory hold or exhibition sponsorship purchase is recommended. Sources: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/ ; https://apexmasterexpos.com/app/events/ ; https://alpha-academy.ticketbud.com/vivavita-masterclasses-in-toronto-leadership-ai-business-marketing
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the announced May 2027 edition, organizer enquiries are publicly accessible via info@gotoapex.com, but hotel sourcing and buyer authority remain unconfirmed. An unannounced venue does not mean open sourcing. Treat as qualification/relationship development, not a bookable room-block lead. Source: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: if the 2027 organizer confirms nonlocal delegates and lodging procurement, seek a limited hotel partnership or room block; otherwise build a relationship for a subsequently announced Toronto cycle. Do not assign a 2028 date, annual Toronto recurrence, future RFP, or incumbent displacement opportunity: none was verified. Sources: https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/toronto-2027/ ; https://www.vivavitaexpos.com/travelworlds/cities/

cibMappingHints.potentialBusiness: Unquantified, conditional organizer/speaker/exhibitor/hosted-buyer lodging and small side meetings; no published room demand.
cibMappingHints.recommendedNextStep: Verify venue, Sheraton relationship, room demand, legal counterparty and named procurement authority before submitting a hotel proposal.
cibMappingHints.accessibilityStatement: Published enquiry channel available; lodging procurement and incumbent allocation unknown.
